why: Each box adds one more line going out from the middle point. Top-left has 2 lines (a V), top-right has 3 (a Y), bottom-left has 4. So the missing box needs 5 lines: all four corner lines plus the line going down. Option 3 fits. Option 2 has only 4 lines and option 1 has a flat line instead of the downward one.
trick: Count the lines that meet at the centre point in each box.
